coordinate_frame: H2 target_frame, carried into H3 without reinterpretation

stand_off.provenance: Historical Stage 0/1 nominal stand-off is carried as a declared H3 baseline parameter; no physical optimum or universal tunnel-surface claim is made.

spray_axis.surface_normal_semantics: H2-oriented unit normal at the sampled surface point

local_axis_mapping.+X: roll tangent selected by deterministic projected reference-axis policy

orientation.rotation_convention: active right-handed rotation mapping TCP-local axes into coordinate_frame

roll_policy.fallback: first reference axis whose projection norm exceeds epsilon
roll_policy.sign_rule: preserve the sign of the selected reference projection; no arbitrary sign flip
roll_policy.discontinuity_policy: reference-axis switching is explicit at degeneracy; continuity is not claimed
